issuer.summary: sUSDe is issued and governed by the same Ethena entity as USDe, so its Issuer score and basis are inherited. Ethena's operating record, attestations and monitoring support the score; concentrated ENA governance and the absence of direct USDe-holder representation constrain it.
issuer.summary_source: Inherited from the completed USDe issuer assessment dated 2026-10-11.
facts: The fee-switch remains dormant below its $7.5bn supply milestone.
USDe and sUSDe holders do not vote in ENA governance solely by holding those assets.
sUSDe-specific cooldown and restriction authority are assessed under Contract and Admin, not Issuer.
